scope: Read-only extraction of the supplied Hush Basin presentation palette for a nonphysical, unregistered Quarto bridge study. Authority participation: none.
notes: Values preserve the source Godot Color and scalar literals numerically. No renderer conversion, tone mapping, or photographic color matching is implied.
The source defines 11 named StandardMaterial3D resources. The exported GLB inventory reports 12 materials because runtime material instances are exported separately.
All listed emission properties have emission_enabled = true in the source scene. The bore resource declares no emission properties; none are inferred here.
Scene resource defaults for energy and nozzle materials are overridden by VehicleVisualRig._apply_energy() after the rig initializes.
Runtime form_amount is clamped to [0, 1]. Base state color = SPREAD_ENERGY.lerp(DRIVE_ENERGY, form_amount), overridden by CAUTION_ENERGY for CAUTION and STRIKE_ENERGY for STRIKE.
Runtime EnergyCore and FixedCore materials: albedo_color = color; emission = color * 0.58; emission_energy_multiplier = lerpf(0.7, 1.35, form_amount).
Runtime propulsion_t: u = clampf((form_amount - 0.88) / maxf(1.00 - 0.88, 0.0001), 0.0, 1.0); propulsion_t = u * u * (3.0 - 2.0 * u).

Runtime NozzleRing material: albedo_color = color.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.18); emission = color * 0.82; emission_energy_multiplier = lerpf(0.22, 1.45, propulsion_t). CanBody and NozzleBore retain their scene material settings.
The animated GLB contains transform animation only and holds SPREAD material state. Static GLBs contain their respective pose material states; dynamic state cues require the source runtime formulas.
Cross-renderer appearance remains unproven. Lighting, exposure, tone mapping, emission handling, and source color interpretation can change the rendered appearance.
This palette creates no frozen authority, physical geometry, keepout, reservation, structure, or volume rights. Accepted BODY-SHELL-03.1 materials and MT1-S5HR3R1 authority remain unchanged.
